stem:
Construct the truth table for each of the following statement patterns.
i) \(p \to (q \to p)\)
ii) \((\sim p \vee q) \leftrightarrow \sim (p \wedge q)\)
iii) \(\sim (\sim p \wedge \sim q) \vee q\)
iv) \([(p \wedge q) \vee r] \wedge [\sim r \vee (p \wedge q)]\)
v) \([(\sim p \vee q) \wedge (q \to r)] \to (p \to r)\)
solution:
i) \(p \to (q \to p)\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(q \to p\) | \(p \to (q \to p)\) |
|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | T | T |
| T | F | T | T |
| F | T | F | T |
| F | F | T | T |

ii) \((\sim p \vee q) \leftrightarrow \sim (p \wedge q)\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(\sim p\) | \(\sim p \vee q\) | \(p \wedge q\) | \(\sim (p \wedge q)\) | \((\sim p \vee q) \leftrightarrow \sim (p \wedge q)\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | F | T | T | F | F |
| T | F | F | F | F | T | F |
| F | T | T | T | F | T | T |
| F | F | T | T | F | T | T |

iii) \(\sim (\sim p \wedge \sim q) \vee q\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(\sim p\) | \(\sim q\) | \(\sim p \wedge \sim q\) | \(\sim (\sim p \wedge \sim q)\) | \(\sim (\sim p \wedge \sim q) \vee q\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | F | F | F | T | T |
| T | F | F | T | F | T | T |
| F | T | T | F | F | T | T |
| F | F | T | T | T | F | F |

iv) \([(p \wedge q) \vee r] \wedge [\sim r \vee (p \wedge q)]\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(r\) | \(\sim r\) | \(p \wedge q\) | \((p \wedge q) \vee r\) | \(\sim r \vee (p \wedge q)\) | \([(p \wedge q) \vee r] \wedge [\sim r \vee (p \wedge q)]\) |

| T | T | T | F | T | T | T | T |
| T | T | F | T | T | T | T | T |

| F | T | F | T | F | F | T | F |
| F | F | T | F | F | T | F | F |
| F | F | F | T | F | F | T | F |

v) \([(\sim p \vee q) \wedge (q \to r)] \to (p \to r)\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(r\) | \(\sim p\) | \(\sim p \vee q\) | \(q \to r\) | \(p \to r\) | \((\sim p \vee q) \wedge (q \to r)\) | \([(\sim p \vee q) \wedge (q \to r)] \to (p \to r)\) |

subtopic: Logical Equivalence and Algebra of Statements
stem:
Using truth tables, prove the following logical equivalences.
i) \((p \wedge q) \equiv \sim (p \to \sim q)\)
ii) \((p \leftrightarrow q) \equiv (p \wedge q) \vee (\sim p \wedge \sim q)\)
iii) \((p \wedge q) \to r \equiv p \to (q \to r)\)
iv) \(p \to (q \vee r) \equiv (p \to q) \vee (p \to r)\)
solution:
i) \((p \wedge q) \equiv \sim (p \to \sim q)\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(\sim q\) | \(p \wedge q\) | \(p \to \sim q\) | \(\sim (p \to \sim q)\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | F | T | F | T |
| T | F | T | F | T | F |
| F | T | F | F | T | F |
| F | F | T | F | T | F |

Columns (IV) and (VI) are identical \(\therefore (p \wedge q) \equiv \sim (p \to \sim q)\)

ii) \((p \leftrightarrow q) \equiv (p \wedge q) \vee (\sim p \wedge \sim q)\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(\sim p\) | \(\sim q\) | \(p \leftrightarrow q\) | \(p \wedge q\) | \(\sim p \wedge \sim q\) | \((p \wedge q) \vee (\sim p \wedge \sim q)\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | F | F | T | T | F | T |
| T | F | F | T | F | F | F | F |
| F | T | T | F | F | F | F | F |
| F | F | T | T | T | F | T | T |

Columns V and VIII are identical \(\therefore (p \leftrightarrow q) \equiv (p \wedge q) \vee (\sim p \wedge \sim q)\)

iii) \((p \wedge q) \to r \equiv p \to (q \to r)\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(r\) | \(p \wedge q\) | \((p \wedge q) \to r\) | \(q \to r\) | \(p \to (q \to r)\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| T | T | F | T | F | F | F |
| T | F | T | F | T | T | T |
| T | F | F | F | T | T | T |
| F | T | T | F | T | T | T |
| F | T | F | F | T | F | T |
| F | F | T | F | T | T | T |
| F | F | F | F | T | T | T |

Column (V) and (VII) are identical \(\therefore (p \wedge q) \to r \equiv p \to (q \to r)\)

iv) \(p \to (q \vee r) \equiv (p \to q) \vee (p \to r)\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(r\) | \(q \vee r\) | \(p \to (q \vee r)\) | \(p \to q\) | \(p \to r\) | \((p \to q) \vee (p \to r)\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| T | T | F | T | T | T | F | T |
| T | F | T | T | T | F | T | T |
| T | F | F | F | F | F | F | F |
| F | T | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| F | T | F | T | T | T | T | T |
| F | F | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| F | F | F | F | T | T | T | T |

Columns V and VIII are identical \(\therefore p \to (q \vee r) \equiv (p \to q) \vee (p \to r)\)

stem:
Using truth tables, examine whether each of the following statement pattern is a tautology or a contradiction or contingency.
i) \((p \wedge q) \wedge (\sim p \vee \sim q)\)
ii) \([p \wedge (p \to \sim q)] \to q\)
iii) \((p \to q) \wedge [(q \to r) \to (p \to r)]\)
iv) \([(p \vee q) \vee r] \leftrightarrow [p \vee (q \vee r)]\)
solution:
i) \((p \wedge q) \wedge (\sim p \vee \sim q)\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(\sim p\) | \(\sim q\) | \(p \wedge q\) | \(\sim p \vee \sim q\) | \((p \wedge q) \wedge (\sim p \vee \sim q)\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | F | F | T | F | F |
| T | F | F | T | F | T | F |
| F | T | T | F | F | T | F |
| F | F | T | T | F | T | F |

All the truth values in the last column are F. Hence it is contradiction.

ii) \([p \wedge (p \to \sim q)] \to q\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(\sim q\) | \(p \to \sim q\) | \(p \wedge (p \to \sim q)\) | \(p \wedge (p \to \sim q) \to q\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | F | F | F | T |
| T | F | T | T | T | F |
| F | T | F | T | F | T |
| F | F | T | T | F | T |

Truth values in the last column are not identical. Hence it is contingency.

iii) \((p \to q) \wedge [(q \to r) \to (p \to r)]\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(r\) | \(p \to q\) | \(q \to r\) | \(p \to r\) | \((q \to r) \to (p \to r)\) | \((p \to q) \wedge (q \to r) \to (p \to r)\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| T | T | F | T | F | F | T | T |
| T | F | T | F | T | T | T | F |
| T | F | F | F | T | F | F | F |
| F | T | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| F | T | F | T | F | T | T | T |
| F | F | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| F | F | F | T | T | T | T | T |

Truth values in the last column are not same, hence it is contingency.

iv) \([(p \vee q) \vee r] \leftrightarrow [p \vee (q \vee r)]\)

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(r\) | \(p \vee q\) | \((p \vee q) \vee r\) | \(q \vee r\) | \(p \vee (q \vee r)\) | \([(p \vee q) \vee r] \leftrightarrow [p \vee (q \vee r)]\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| T | T | F | T | T | T | T | T |
| T | F | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| T | F | F | T | T | F | T | T |
| F | T | T | T | T | T | T | T |
| F | T | F | T | T | T | T | T |
| F | F | T | F | T | T | T | T |
| F | F | F | F | F | F | F | T |

All the truth values in the last column are T, hence it is tautology.
